cards.bg-title: Flat 2D naturalist field-guide illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, clean shapes, gentle cel shading, warm parchment cream, moss green, ochre and slate-blue palette, thin warm-brown outlines, no 3D, no photo realism, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. A sunrise view over a naturalist's field station: a wooden bird feeder on a post in the foreground, a forest edge on the left, a golden meadow in the middle and a reed-fringed lake on the right, small birds flying in a soft pale sky, calm empty sky in the top third.
